120046.name: Chabad Coastal Hebrew School
120046.note: North County Blade-Citizen, Sept 1 1990 ('Chabad opens school'; California Digital Newspaper Collection): 'Chabad at La Costa, 7663 Galleon Way, announces the opening of a Talmud Torah Hebrew school. The Talmud Torah is for children ages 6 to 13 and will meet twice a week in the afternoons ... Classes will begin during the week of Sept. 10 ... Call Rabbi Eilfort'. This listing is Chabad at La Costa's Hebrew school (Rabbi Yeruchem Eilfort; the center from 1989).

earlier.where: 7663 Galleon Way, Carlsbad (Chabad at La Costa's first address)
1980 La Costa Ave, on the La Costa Resort and Spa's grounds (from June 1991, 'two classrooms ... afternoon Hebrew School')

117941.name: Chabad at La Costa
117941.note: The center's own pages: 'In the summer of 1989 the Eilforts moved to San Diego ... and founded Chabad at La Costa by having High Holiday services'; 'founded in the summer of '89'; its LinkedIn: founded 1989. (They moved to Carlsbad itself in 1990.)

earlier.where: 1980 La Costa Ave, on the property of La Costa Resort and Spa ('larger facilities ... two classrooms, a large yard ... a large synagogue and social hall', dedicated June 2 1991)
